stories.title: Wildfires near Spokane have burned thousands of acres and displaced many more
stories.summary: Wildfires near Spokane, Wash., have burned at least 7,000 acres, destroyed hundreds of homes and forced the evacuation of tens of thousands of people.

stories.title: Infertility doctor secretly fathered dozens of children: how strangers became family. Part 3
stories.summary:
Dozens of people who grew up around Philadelphia learned decades later
they shared the same biological father, a pioneering infertility doctor.

stories.title: With U.S. doors shutting, Cubans turn to Brazil for asylum
stories.summary: For years, many Cubans hoping to leave the island looked to the United States. Now, with legal pathways largely closed, a growing number are heading to Brazil instead.

stories.title: Climate change is changing how Texas farmers handle their peach harvests
stories.summary: Texas experienced its warmest winter on record since 1895 and the state's farmers say those high temperatures hampered their peach harvest.

stories.title: Rural California school district creates space where kids can learn to swim
stories.summary: Not everyone has access to a public pool. But a rural school district in California just pulled together funding for a new aquatic center so kids can learn to swim.

stories.title: Megan Rapinoe says next year's Women's World Cup "is going to be lit"
stories.summary: Missing the World Cup? Well the 2027 Women's World Cup is just around the corner. Host Juana Summers talks about that with former US national team star Megan Rapinoe.
